sloka: आनयेङ्गुदिपिण्याकं चीरमाहर चोत्तरम् ।जलक्रियार्थं तातस्य गमिष्यामि महात्मन: ॥ २.१०२.२०॥
transliteration: ānayeṅgudipiṇyākaṁ cīramāhara cottaram ।jalakriyārthaṁ tātasya gamiṣyāmi mahātmana: ॥ 2.102.20॥

translations.english: I shall go and offer libations to my magnanimous father. Go and fetch the dried pulp of ingudi fruit and an upper garment made of bark.
